detail.body:
# What does this PR do?

Upgrade W&B to 0.30.0 in the Bridge package and Framework image, including the separate system installation inherited from the base image. This replaces the older bundled Go components in both `wandb-core` copies.

# Changelog

- Raise the Bridge dependency and UV override to `wandb>=0.30.0`, and pin the Framework environment to `wandb==0.30.0`.
- Regenerate `uv.lock` with `uv lock --upgrade-package wandb==0.30.0` inside the Bridge CI container.
- Replace both custom `wandb-core` source rebuilds with the packaged binaries. The existing rebuilds retained older Go/gRPC pins; the 0.30.0 Linux wheels contain Go 1.27.1, `golang.org/x/crypto` 0.57.0, gRPC 1.83.2, and go-git 5.19.2.
- Explicitly upgrade W&B using `/usr/bin/python3` for the system copy; the Framework UV sync upgrades `/opt/venv`. The system install permits modification of the container's externally managed interpreter.

# Lockfile delta

```text
Updated wandb 0.29.0 -> 0.30.0
Added googleapis-common-protos 1.75.5
Added opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common 1.44.0
Added opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http 1.44.0
```

These additions satisfy W&B 0.30.0's new OTLP exporter dependencies. Other locked package versions and the MCore submodule are unchanged.

# Validation

- [x] `uv lock --check` in the Bridge CI container.
- [x] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` in the Bridge CI container.
- [x] Executed the new Dockerfile system-install command in a disposable Framework container after upgrading the venv copy.
- [x] Both Python interpreters report W&B 0.30.0 and pass offline `init` / `log` / `finish`, producing an offline run artifact.
- [x] Both installed amd64 `wandb-core` files byte-match the audited official 0.30.0 wheel. Official amd64 and arm64 wheel build metadata contains the fixed component versions listed above.
- [x] `git diff --check`.
- [ ] L0 CI green.
- [ ] L1 CI green (`needs-more-tests` label applied).

A full Framework image build and GPU suites were not run locally. No tests have been quarantined.

@@ -107,45 +107,9 @@ RUN pip install "fastapi==0.139.1" \
 # The actual onnx Python package is managed above via pip/uv; this stale copy triggers CVE scanners.
 RUN rm -rf /opt/pytorch/pytorch/third_party/onnx
 
-# Rebuild wandb-core with fixed versions compatible with wandb 0.29.0.
-ARG TARGETARCH
-RUN GRPC_VERSION=1.83.2 && \
-    GO_VERSION=1.27.0 && \
-    WANDB_VERSION=$(python3 -c "import wandb; print(wandb.__version__)") && \
-    WANDB_CORE_BIN=/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/wandb/bin/wandb-core && \
-    curl -fsSL "https://dl.google.com/go/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${TARGETARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -C /tmp -xz && \
-    export PATH="/tmp/go/bin:$PATH" && \
-    export GOPATH=/tmp/gopath && \
-    git clone --depth 1 --branch "v${WANDB_VERSION}" https://github.com/wandb/wandb.git /tmp/wandb-src && \
-    cd /tmp/wandb-src/core && \
-    go get google.golang.org/grpc@v${GRPC_VERSION} && \
-    go mod tidy && \
-    go mod vendor && \
-    CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=${TARGETARCH} go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" \
-        -o "${WANDB_CORE_BIN}" ./cmd/wandb-core/ && \
-    rm -rf /tmp/wandb-src /tmp/go /tmp/gopath
-
-# Patch wandb-core (dist-packages copy) with fixed go-git, gRPC-Go, and Go versions.
-# This stock upstream binary ships with go-git v5.17.2 and is a separate wandb install from the
-# /opt/venv copy rebuilt above, so it must be rebuilt against its own wandb version (resolved via
-# the system interpreter that owns dist-packages) to avoid a python/wandb-core version mismatch.
-RUN GO_GIT_VERSION=5.19.2 && \
-    GRPC_VERSION=1.83.0 && \
-    GO_VERSION=1.26.5 && \
-    WANDB_VERSION=$(/usr/bin/python3 -c "import wandb; print(wandb.__version__)") && \
-    WANDB_CORE_BIN=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/wandb/bin/wandb-core && \
-    curl -fsSL "https://dl.google.com/go/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${TARGETARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -C /tmp -xz && \
-    export PATH="/tmp/go/bin:$PATH" && \
-    export GOPATH=/tmp/gopath && \
-    git clone --depth 1 --branch "v${WANDB_VERSION}" https://github.com/wandb/wandb.git /tmp/wandb-src && \
-    cd /tmp/wandb-src/core && \
-    go get github.com/go-git/go-git/v5@v${GO_GIT_VERSION} && \
-    go get google.golang.org/grpc@v${GRPC_VERSION} && \
-    go mod tidy && \
-    go mod vendor && \
-    CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=${TARGETARCH} go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" \
-        -o "${WANDB_CORE_BIN}" ./cmd/wandb-core/ && \
-    rm -rf /tmp/wandb-src /tmp/go /tmp/gopath
+# W&B 0.30.0 bundles the fixed wandb-core binary. The uv sync above upgrades the
+# venv copy; update the separate system installation inherited from the base image.
+RUN uv pip install --python /usr/bin/python3 --break-system-packages --no-cache "wandb==0.30.0"
